topic.title: Scene Organization and Structure-Aware Segmentation
topic.overview: Segmentation and scene interpretation assign coherent regions, objects, and boundaries to visual input. This cluster combines spatial probabilistic models, grouping cues, multiscale fields, and structured priors. Rather than treating pixels independently, methods represent how parts and object instances fit together, sometimes with uncertainty about how many objects are present.
topic.whyItMatters: Appearance varies across images and domains, while spatial or anatomical relationships can remain more stable. Incorporating that structure can reduce annotation needs and prevent locally plausible predictions from forming globally inconsistent shapes.
topic.evolution: Early examples use neural color segmentation and perceptual organization. The 2000s representatives develop shared probabilistic components, figure-ground cue integration, and contour models. Recent applications bring deformable anatomical priors and structure-preserving decompositions to medical segmentation, adapting the broader idea of coherent shape modeling to cross-domain data.
openQuestions: How can structural priors remain helpful when anatomy or object layout is atypical?
Which uncertainty measures reveal disagreement about object count or boundary placement?

papers.tldr: Submodular field grammars make individual region splits tractable and enable efficient approximate parsing of hierarchical image structure.

papers.title: A Similarity-preserving Network Trained on Transformed Images Recapitulates Salient Features of the Fly Motion Detection Circuit
papers.tldr: A similarity-preserving learning objective produces a biologically plausible motion network that reproduces key features of the fly motion detector.

papers.title: Region Mutual Information Loss for Semantic Segmentation
papers.tldr: Region mutual information loss trains segmentation models to capture neighboring-pixel dependencies, improving reported accuracy without testing overhead.

papers.title: Distribution Matching for Crowd Counting
papers.tldr: DM-Count replaces Gaussian-smoothed supervision with optimal-transport distribution matching, improving crowd-counting results and the stated generalization bound.

papers.title: HOI Analysis: Integrating and Decomposing Human-Object Interaction
papers.tldr: Learning to integrate and decompose human-object representations provides a transformation-based representation of actions and improves interaction detection.

papers.title: What does LIME really see in images?
papers.tldr: A theoretical analysis characterizes LIME’s large-sample image explanations and connects them to integrated gradients aggregated over superpixels.

papers.title: Spot the Difference: Detection of Topological Changes via Geometric Alignment
papers.tldr: A conditional variational autoencoder detects topological changes during image registration, with validation on cell microscopy and brain-image anomaly detection.

papers.title: Generative Status Estimation and Information Decoupling for Image Rain Removal
papers.tldr: SEIDNet samples possible pixel identities and restoration kernels to separate rain from object detail, with strong results across several restoration tasks.

papers.title: On Image Segmentation With Noisy Labels: Characterization and Volume Properties of the Optimal Solutions to Accuracy and Dice
papers.tldr: With noisy segmentation labels, Accuracy and Dice can favor different volumes, but their optima coincide under an expected-target-volume constraint.

papers.title: On the symmetries of the synchronization problem in Cryo-EM: Multi-Frequency Vector Diffusion Maps on the Projective Plane
papers.tldr: Using O(2) pairwise relationships, an extended diffusion-map method recovers cryo-EM image poses up to molecular handedness and supports reconstruction initialization.

papers.title: Pluralistic Image Completion with Gaussian Mixture Models
papers.tldr: A probabilistic image-completion framework uses an adaptive Gaussian mixture model to generate and control diverse plausible results.

papers.title: Revisiting Sliced Wasserstein on Images: From Vectorization to Convolution
papers.tldr: Convolution sliced Wasserstein replaces flattened-image projections with convolutional slicing to better accommodate image structure and memory demands.

papers.title: dugMatting: Decomposed-Uncertainty-Guided Matting
papers.tldr: dugMatting separates uncertainty sources to guide user input and statistical modeling, improving image matting efficiency and quality.

papers.title: Learning Affinity with Hyperbolic Representation for Spatial Propagation
papers.tldr: HAM uses hyperbolic distances to learn hierarchical pixel affinities and can improve depth completion and semantic segmentation.

papers.title: Predictive Flows for Faster Ford-Fulkerson
papers.tldr: Seeding Ford-Fulkerson with predicted flows yields prediction-quality-dependent performance guarantees and strong image-segmentation results.

papers.title: RVD: A Handheld Device-Based Fundus Video Dataset for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
papers.tldr: RVD provides handheld retinal videos with vessel and pulsation annotations, exposing challenges beyond conventional bench-top image datasets.

papers.title: SegRefiner: Towards Model-Agnostic Segmentation Refinement with Discrete Diffusion Process
papers.tldr: SegRefiner progressively denoises coarse segmentation masks with discrete diffusion, improving mask quality and fine boundaries across several segmentation tasks.

papers.title: Compositional Image Decomposition with Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Decomp Diffusion separates an image into generative components that can be recombined to create substantially different scenes.

papers.title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Anatomical Structure Detection in Ultrasound Images
papers.tldr: ToMo-UDA uses anatomical relationships and morphology to improve fetal ultrasound structure detection across institutions.

papers.title: Arctique: An artificial histopathological dataset unifying realism and controllability for uncertainty quantification
papers.tldr: Arctique provides complex synthetic tissue images with independently controllable image and label uncertainty for evaluating segmentation uncertainty methods.

papers.title: Are nuclear masks all you need for improved out-of-domain generalisation? A closer look at cancer classification in histopathology
papers.tldr: Training with nuclear masks and aligned image representations improves cancer-detection generalization across datasets and increases robustness.

papers.title: Fast Tree-Field Integrators: From Low Displacement Rank to Topological Transformers
papers.tldr: Structured-matrix methods accelerate tree-field integration, with mostly exact algorithms and applications extending to Topological Transformers.

papers.title: GraphMorph: Tubular Structure Extraction by Morphing Predicted Graphs
papers.tldr: GraphMorph predicts branch graphs and converts them into centerline masks to improve tubular topology and reduce segmentation false positives.

papers.title: Infusing Synthetic Data with Real-World Patterns for Zero-Shot Material State Segmentation
papers.tldr: The paper enriches synthetic materials with automatically extracted natural patterns and reports improved segmentation of material states on a new benchmark.

papers.title: Unsupervised Homography Estimation on Multimodal Image Pair via Alternating Optimization
papers.tldr: AltO learns homographies without ground-truth mappings by alternating between geometric alignment and reducing cross-modality differences.

papers.title: Field Matching: an Electrostatic Paradigm to Generate and Transfer Data
papers.tldr: Electrostatic Field Matching learns a capacitor-inspired field whose trajectories transport samples between distributions for generation and transfer.

papers.title: L-Diffusion: Laplace Diffusion for Efficient Pathology Image Segmentation
papers.tldr: L-Diffusion combines Laplace-based feature modeling with contrastive learning to improve reported tissue and cell segmentation performance.

papers.title: Gate to the Vessel: Residual Experts Restore What SAM Overlooks
papers.tldr: FineSAM++ routes uncertain vessel regions to a lightweight correction expert, improving segmentation accuracy and structural consistency across five datasets.

papers.title: GauSAM: Contour‑Guided 2D Gaussian Fields for Multi‑Scale Medical Image Segmentation with Segment Anything
papers.tldr: GauSAM combines continuous Gaussian mask fields with contour guidance to improve multiscale medical segmentation using 1.2 million trainable parameters.

papers.title: GPSToken: Gaussian Parameterized Spatially-adaptive Tokenization for Image Representation and Generation
papers.tldr: GPSToken represents images with adaptable Gaussian regions, separating layout from texture for compact reconstruction and two-stage generation.

papers.title: Learning to Zoom with Anatomical Relations for Medical Structure Detection
papers.tldr: ZR-DETR combines zoom-sensitive features, anatomical constraints, and probabilistic detection to improve medical structure localization.

papers.title: LocDiff: Identifying Locations on Earth by Diffusing in the Hilbert Space
papers.tldr: LocDiff generates image geolocations through diffusion in a multiscale spherical representation, improving results and generalization to unseen locations.

papers.title: Mamba Goes HoME: Hierarchical Soft Mixture-of-Experts for 3D Medical Image Segmentation
papers.tldr: HoME adds local and global expert routing to Mamba, improving reported 3D medical-image segmentation across modalities and data qualities.

papers.title: Optical Coherence Tomography Harmonization with Anatomy-Guided Latent Metric Schrödinger Bridges
papers.tldr: An anatomy-guided latent distance improves Schrödinger-bridge harmonization of OCT images across scanner appearances.

papers.title: RankSEG-RMA: An Efficient Segmentation Algorithm via Reciprocal Moment Approximation
papers.tldr: RankSEG-RMA makes overlap-metric-aware segmentation linear in pixel count and extends it to mutually exclusive pixel classes.

papers.title: Towards Generalizable Retina Vessel Segmentation with Deformable Graph Priors
papers.tldr: GraphSeg combines retinal anatomy priors with image decomposition to improve vessel segmentation across domains.
